tasks.short: Provide professional consulting services to government or industry, and send the note she writes.

steps.what: Provide professional consulting by meeting government or industry and hearing the question.
Write the consulting services note herself from the question government or industry asked.
Read the consulting services note and judge whether the advice answers the question.
Send the consulting services note to the government or industry contact.

tasks.design: She meets the government or industry contact and writes the consulting note in the {DOCS} herself. She reads that note and sends the same version from the {EMAIL} only when the advice answers the question she heard. The meeting stays hers.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice turns on the question the contact asks and on her judgement of the texts, which a fixed rule cannot settle.
tasks.enabler_now: She already writes the note and sends it. No new system is required for this engagement.
tasks.still_hard: Judging what a ministry or a firm should be told, and standing behind that advice.
tasks.human_edge: She is the person accountable for consulting advice that leaves the university.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still meets the contact, still writes the note, and still decides which version is sent.

reach.task: Advise educators on a curriculum the faculty already discussed.
reach.learn: Which curriculum question the faculty has already answered, so her note to a ministry does not repeat it.

evidence.claim: This consulting is a meeting, a note she writes, and a mail she sends. Products in the digest mark closed questions, group exam answers, or comment on student writing. None of them carries an English teacher's advice to government or industry.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is one consulting engagement with government or industry. Teaching, grading, and research sit in other tasks.
Named fields on the question are topic and requester. The government or industry contact produces them in the meeting. An empty topic means she does not write the note.
Named fields on the note are the question heard and her advice. She produces both while writing. The read checks that the advice answers the question, not a reference number.
The send uses the version she already read. A later edit of the note voids that read, and she reads the new text before sending.
No system is configured for this task, so a native-configuration test does not arise. Mail and document runtime is not her effort and is not counted as a saving.

In-person share 35 follows meetings near 34.2. Document shares 45 and 8 follow documents near 47.5 plus the small screen and workbook remainder near 5.6, which is not a separate workbook step. Mail share 12 follows mail near 12.6.
A works council exists at 200 to 2,000 staff. No new system is introduced, so no consent file is opened.
Incremental hours are 0 because no upkeep or exception queue is added.
unknowns: Whether this employer requires a dean to clear outside consulting before the note is sent.
Whether the contact wants only the meeting, or also the written note.
research_questions: Does a dean already clear outside consulting at this employer, and does that clearance sit outside this task?

incremental.description: No upkeep. She keeps the meeting, the note, the read, and the send, and no queue is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No step is shortened. The meeting, the writing, the read, and the send all stay at full time, including a year with no engagement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still provides the consulting herself: the meeting with government or industry, the note, and the decision to send it.
reach: From an instructional coordinator, learn which curriculum question the faculty has already answered before she advises a ministry.
skills_to_grow: Hearing the consulting question in the meeting
Judging whether the note answers that question before it is sent
role.ambitious_version: She still meets government or industry and still sends the advice herself. Nothing is written in her place.

job.title: English Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
